$comment: CANONICAL OUT-OF-SCOPE COMPLAINT TAXONOMY — deliberately MINIMAL. OUT_OF_SCOPE requires POSITIVE evidence that a complaint belongs to another clinical domain; an unrecognised complaint is NEEDS_MORE_INFO, never OUT_OF_SCOPE. This file therefore lists only categories the team is confident are outside obstetric/paediatric scope, and says nothing about how serious they are. Classifying something out of scope is a statement about CareBridge's coverage, not about the user's risk.

policy.$comment: All three must hold before OUT_OF_SCOPE may be returned. The safety screen requirement is why 'đau cổ tay' is not instantly out of scope: we must first know the person is not also short of breath.
